information: raw y, power-scaled pilot+x_soft, S0 and aligned final estimated gains; no truth or decoder feedback
placement: one terminal channel refit after unchanged10 outer iterations and before single20BP/LDPC50; no extra terminal decode

center_selection.sort: descending abs(final estimated gain)^2, ties ascending atom ID
center_selection.dedup: skip candidate if same delay and integer Doppler distance <=1 from an already selected center
center_selection.domain: center Doppler + [-0.5,0.5], intersect [-2,2]; delay fixed; center count <=min(8,K), never read true physical path count
center_selection.source: S0 from existing OMP nomination and unchanged outer receiver, not truth support

template: physical_cluster_weights with observed centers and queried Doppler only; full normalization/prune/clip then restrict S0, no renormalization after restriction

m-group.groups: disjoint partition of all S0 by observed delay label
m-group.nonconvergence: explicit failed frame, not a beaten classical method
m-group.dual_protocol: Converged reference may also serve same-budget only if actual full timing satisfies allocation; otherwise no same-budget assertion.

m-param-budget.solver: separable least squares via shared SVD minimum-norm _fit_ls
m-param-budget.selection: one deterministic coordinate sweep, centers in frozen selection order; evaluate clipped unique local-grid values including current value; choose strictly lower raw squared residual, ties keep current
m-param-budget.reference_scope: bounded local grid adaptation, not full NOMP or global optimum

m-param-reference.stop: whole sweep accepts no coordinate change; otherwise cap is explicit unconverged reference
m-param-reference.selection: minimum raw residual across initializations, ties earlier initialization
m-param-reference.reference_scope: coordinate-stationary on registered finite grid only; not continuous optimum; report nonconvergence and budget failure

m-soft.geometry: exact m-param-budget one-sweep selection; no extra query
m-soft.solver: soft subspace-constrained LS: min ||y-A g||² + lambda_soft||(I-U U^H)g||², U retained left singular vectors of restricted W
m-soft.interpretation: finite quadratic relaxation preserves S0 coefficients outside estimated physical span; classical regularization form, no novelty claim
m-soft.solve: shared SVD minimum-norm on augmented [A;sqrt(lambda_soft)*(I-U U^H)] and [y;0]
m-soft.instability: rank-deficient/overlapping W allowed with explicit SVD rank; no extra slots, hard fallback or hidden jitter

SVD: reuse _fit_ls/_svd eps*max(shape)*largest_singular_value rank threshold; report rank/singular values

edge_cases.K0: zero channel and zero gains, retain frame, no query
edge_cases.zero_basis: budget/reference return declared zero minimum-norm channel with rank0; soft solve uses U empty and classical ridge; label zero basis and fallback-to-ridge explicitly
edge_cases.nonfinite: raise, preserve failed frame and debit attempted calls
edge_cases.rank_deficiency: minimum-norm solution and explicit rank, no redrawing or hidden damping
